extension_rationale: The v1 protocol declared base + three BFS-adapter cells and is complete. The user then explicitly requested testing the remaining nine trained adapters (best_first_width, best_first_add_w3, best_first_add_greedy x text/visual/multimodal). This extension is exhaustive over every remaining verified trained cell — it does not select adapters by observed transfer success — and reuses the v1 frozen subsets, prompts, decoding, parsing, sandbox and metrics unchanged. It was authorized after the v1 BFS transfer results were observed; that timing is disclosed here and in the published narrative.

base_model.note: identical pin to v1; the base cell was already run under v1 and is not rerun

benchmarks.note: v2 reuses the v1 frozen subsets (outputs/expanded-study/v1/transfer/subsets.json sha256 24157aaadc6f3c2b1bf7ff1e858a3a7bef93f98f68354d8d1334b30bfaa12627), prompts, max_new_tokens (folio 64 / gsm8k 512 / humaneval 768), parsing rules, sandbox contract and metrics byte-identically. No re-selection, no re-freezing of examples, no new benchmark content. The v1 freeze stage must verify and reference, never regenerate.

resource_gate.probe_examples: same representative probe design as v1 (p50/p95 input-token-length examples of the frozen L0 subsets plus the min-length guard), executed for all nine v2 cells to re-verify scalar/batch parity, repeated-batch determinism, adapter isolation and token guards for these specific adapters and to measure per-benchmark p95 latency

admission_rule.L0: full frozen v1 subsets x 9 cells; estimated from probe p95 per-example latency x subset size x 9 cells plus model-load per worker, times safety factor 1.25, must fit the transfer branch remainder (24 - already spent) and the absolute GPU cutoff 2026-09-21T11:55:19Z
admission_rule.L1: frozen v1 L1 subsets (even positions of the L0 orders) x 9 cells, used only if L0 does not fit

evidence.publication: docs/experiments/expanded-study/transfer-v2-*.json + transfer-v2-results.md; v1 evidence under outputs/expanded-study/v1/transfer/ and docs/experiments/expanded-study/transfer-* is never overwritten
evidence.valid_stop_contract: as v1: VALID_STOP for resource or ordinary threshold failure; INVALID for provenance/replay/execution mismatch
